`interface IRenderBridge`<br/>
**Extends:** [`IBridge`](/reference/bridges/ibridge/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`RenderBridge`](/reference/bridges/renderbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IRenderBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/IRenderBridge.java)

The bridge that draws every pixel of JOID: it clears targets, draws triangles and lines, and creates textures, framebuffers and shaders.

## Description

The core reads it from `BridgeHandler.RENDER`; [`DrawUtils`](/reference/drawing/drawutils/) goes through it.
A backend extends [`RenderBridge`](/reference/bridges/renderbridge/), which implements the state, the matrices and the frame and leaves the GPU calls to write.
Every method runs on the render thread.
This node reads it to find its area in screen pixels, then lets the host draw there:

```java file="com/example/backend/HostPreviewNode.java" region="draw"
```

## Method details

<a id="IRenderBridge-method-isFrameActive"></a>

### isFrameActive

`boolean isFrameActive()` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

If `true`, a frame is begun; `true` by default.

<a id="IRenderBridge-method-canWrap"></a>

### canWrap

`boolean canWrap(TextureWrap wrap)` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

If `true`, the API samples with that wrap; `true` by default.
When it returns `false`, JOID samples with `CLAMP_TO_EDGE`, and emulates `CLAMP_TO_BORDER` in the shaders.

### withState

`void withState(Consumer<IRenderBridge> body)` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

<a id="IRenderBridge-method-screen"></a>

### screen

`void screen(int width, int height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Targets the window: no framebuffer, a viewport of that size in screen pixels, and an orthographic projection from the top-left corner with depth from `0` to `10000`.
[`UIBridgeRegistry.frame`](/reference/backends/uibridgeregistry/#UIBridgeRegistry-method-frame) calls it when the window changes size.

### draw

`void draw(Primitive primitive, VertexBuffer buffer)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Draws the vertices as triangles or lines with the current shader, or the default one, and the current state.
Skips the draw when the shader is not active, the buffer is empty or the viewport has no area.
